summary: BD said Tuesday it has struck a partnership with the Trump administration to expand domestic manufacturing and strengthen the supply chain for medical consumables. BD, a maker of syringes, needles, infusion pumps and other medical products, said it will invest a total of $19 billion in the U.S. over several years. The pact includes investments in U.S. manufacturing, innovation and end-to-end production capabilities, the company said. The agreement provides relief from any future tariffs on BD products under Section 232, subject to BD achieving undisclosed milestones.
